title: NetworkConsentChangedPayload
description: network.consent.changed v1 (OpenVibe.Network, L24): a person turned a purpose on or off, an app's grant was revoked, or a choice expired. A service that caches consent answers drops that subject's answers for the purpose at once; one that is running a use for the subject (a dataset build, a recognition, an AI text) checks again before it goes on. The payload names the change and never the content it covers.

on.description: Whether the purpose is allowed after the change.
